::: {.recipe-meta}
**Serves:** 4\
**Prep time:** 15 minutes\
**Cook time:** 30 minutes

[Side]{.badge .badge-side} [Vegetarian]{.badge .badge-vegetarian}
:::

*These will give lasting luck if consumed on New Year's Eve.*

## Ingredients

- 2 lbs Brussels sprouts (halved or quartered)
- 1 onion (sliced)
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 tbsp butter
- 2 tsp garlic salt
- 1 tsp lemon pepper

## Instructions

1. Place Brussels sprouts flat side down in pan of olive oil and butter.
2. Add the onion.
3. Season with garlic salt and lemon pepper.
4. Cover and sear until the sprouts are dark and caramelized.
